page_title: Days since Codex pet broken — Issue observatory
description: An independent, source-linked observatory of Codex desktop-pet input failures. Reports, references, and hypotheses kept distinct.
headline: Still looking for the hitbox.
counter_unit: days since this report was filed
counter_detail: Completed 24-hour periods between the report's creation and this snapshot. Not a measure of uninterrupted breakage.
satire: The mascot has a body. The mouse is still looking for it.
scope: A curated map of public reports, not a complete bug census. The center is an editorial choice, not an official master issue.
network_hint: Follow an issue to GitHub. Arrows show which report references which; other connections are undirected.
graph_description: Each labeled node links to its GitHub issue. The relationship ledger below gives a text equivalent, source links, and the meaning of every connection.
graph_scroll: Scroll the diagram horizontally on narrow screens, or use the text ledger below.
reference_description: A link in an issue body or comment. Automated potential-duplicate suggestions count as references, not decisions.
official_duplicate_description: A verified maintainer decision or a GitHub duplicate event. Automated suggestions and community consolidation comments do not qualify.
similarity_description: An editorial comparison of symptoms. Similar descriptions do not establish the same defect.
hypothesis_description: An unconfirmed explanation that might connect reports. It is not an official diagnosis.
opposite_description: Contrasting observed outcomes: input passes through the pet versus transparent space blocking input.
index_intro: Original titles are kept for traceability. The short descriptions are editorial summaries. Closed does not, by itself, mean fixed.
refresh_hint: Optional, unauthenticated requests to GitHub. Updates issue-state labels below only; the snapshot, graph, counter, and reviewed relationships stay unchanged.
refresh_partial: Checked {count} of {total} issue states at {time}. Unavailable issues retain their previous labels.
refresh_failed: GitHub is unavailable or rate-limited. Previous labels and the static snapshot are preserved.
refresh_cooldown: You can check again in one minute.
snapshot_only: Showing the captured snapshot. No live requests have been made.
relationship_intro: Every connection below has a source. An explicit reference proves that somebody linked two reports; it does not prove a shared cause.
no_relationships: No verified entries in this category. An empty category is better than an invented decision.
method_title: What this clock can—and cannot—tell you
method_counter: The counter starts at the creation of #34227, selected because it explicitly describes the visible pet and its usable input area drifting apart. Earlier, display-specific reports are included as context. This is not a claim about the first occurrence of every pet bug.
method_state: GitHub state is administrative metadata. A closure, a duplicate suggestion, or a community workaround does not verify a shipped fix. This clock does not reset on closure, and this site does not claim to test each desktop release.
method_selection: The initial selection follows a bounded chain of input and hit-region reports from May–August 2026. It omits many adjacent reports and references. Absence from this map is not absence of a report or of internal engineering work.
method_privacy: The site stores public issue metadata, short editorial summaries, and evidence links. Issue bodies, comments, attachments, and diagnostic identifiers stay on GitHub. No analytics, embedded credentials, or background API polling.
footer: Facts first. Satire second. Hit testing pending.
unaffiliated: Independent project; not affiliated with OpenAI.
no_script: The full snapshot and source ledger work without JavaScript.
